text:
Minoh Falls and Katsuo-ji: no bus links them
since March 2025.
The fix: do the day backwards 👇

🚌 Up by bus
Midosuji Line to Minoh-Kayano,
then Hankyu Bus 30 to Katsuo-ji.
About 20 minutes, ¥800.
No cash on that bus: tap an IC card.

🔴 The daruma temple
Katsuo-ji opens at 8:00. ¥500.
Daruma on walls, rocks and roofs.

🌲 Down on foot
About 80 minutes to the 33 m falls.
Then about 40 along the river to Minoh Station.

⏰ Last bus down from Katsuo-ji: 17:05.

👉 The full route:
https://japanbystation.com/minoh-falls-to-katsuoji-walk-or-bus

Hike down, or bus both ways? 🥾
